text:
What a great experience.  My friend had the famous Bloody Mary, and it did not disappoint!  
Food was amazing. Service was spot on. It was very clean.  
I had the Reuben sandwich and homemade chips, it was so good, cooked to perfection.
I also had the homemade soup of the day, it was a creamy chicken vegetable soup. Melted in my mouth.  I want more just thinking about it. I will be a frequent flyer at this establishment!  Thank you Tick Tock! Awesome job!

Update: changing the review to 4 stars instead of 5 because even though the mall is big and cool I've had terrible service at multiple restaurants here namely Claim Jumper and Johnny Rockets . The Aquarium restaurant was ok , better service than the rest by comparison , really cool atmosphere , but just ok food. I would stick to the food court or the Aquarium place if you are happy enough with eating ok food next to a really cool fish tank.

Wonderful gem of a restaurant! Local, fresh, QUALITY ingredients in beautifully orchestrated recipes. They also have a few seasonal items. The hardest part was deciding on what to order. They also take food allergies/preferences very seriously, so you know you can safely eat here. We will be back!
We love stopping by Bricktops for dessert! Our favorite is the chocolate chip skillet cookie- it's so tasty and perfect for splitting amongst 3-4 people!

My go-to Dim Sum spot in the tampa area. They only serve it until 2:45pm, I recommend calling in your order 15 mins ahead of time to avoid the wait as they're only offering takeout right now. The chili oil is MUST, make sure to ask for some. My go-to's the steamed ribs in black bean sauce, steamed pork buns and the shu mai.

This spot has been my go to when I want to grab a beer during Covid. The staff is kind, helpful, and respectful of the guidelines. The patio In the back on the river is huge, with fire pits on the uncovered part and a fireplace on covered side. 

Food/drink: 4.5 stars - the beer is top notch. My favorite is the Belgium triple and the schwarzbier. With Covid I've only tried a few of the apps but I've heard awesome things about the sushi! 

Service: 5 stars - Amanda is great along with the rest of the staff. They are all helpful and make you feel comfortable. When I was here with my parents they let us change tables from a high top to a lower table without issues.

Atmosphere: 5 stars - The patio is huge and very spacious for Covid times. I've sat in the uncovered and the covered part. Both are awesome but can't wait to hang out at the huge inside bar.

This place was great in quality but the portion was small. It's a good place in the French quarter for a light lunch (hard to come by something not deep fried or covered with cheese) and they clearly label what's gluten free and/or what's vegan.

The front cashier needs be better trained in what's in each entree item though- he told me that the gluten free crab cake didn't have crab in it when in fact the kitchen corrected him to say that it has. 

I might return for the crab cake po boy and crab cake tacos.

Realizing I have not updated my review in 5 years is heartbreaking!! So here we go...

THIS PLACE IS STILL THE BEST! 

Period.

Nothing more to say! If you have eaten here... you get it, if you haven't... what are you waiting for... GO NOW!  

There is a reason it's been voted "best sandwich" for literally ever!! (Ok, like 30 years... but that's a long time!!)  Yes, technically, it's gas station food! But it's more like a quick order restaurant with a gas station in it!  All the bread is HEAVEN!  My favorite is the onion Swiss bread!  You can pile it high with all different kinds of meat and cheese!! (I usually get the turkey and pepper jack, but follow your taste buds, and order what you want) then the veggie selection... oooh the veggie selection!! You can add basically every veggie ever made on your sandwich!  .. But a word of warning... to many veggies means you can't fit the sandwich in your mouth!  I know! It's a weird problem, but a real one when ordering here!!(insert "that's what she said" joke here)   Then you take your sandwich and can shop for sides (in the entire gas station) !  And finally you pay at the main gas station check out.  

I've heard they make a mean soup, but I have never tried it!! (See the 8000 yelp reviews raving about it). Their French dip is to die for!! And their kids pack is wonderful! It comes with a mini sandwich, juice, Pringle's, AND A COOKIE!! Yep, I've stolen that from my daughter on more then a few occasions... please don't call CPS!

I came here with my dad. First we were told that it was a half hour wait because the kitchen was backed up and after about 20 minutes we asked to just be seated so we could at least get drinks. That was after searching for the hostess who was nowhere to be found in the front. Our waitress was very nice but slow. There was still a very long wait to actually get our meals. While we were waiting the manager came out and told us that we could get a complementary dessert as a thank you for being patient which was very nice. But then our meals came out incomplete and wrong. My dad ordered wings which said they came with celery and blue cheese and his wings came with ranch and no celery. I ordered the old-timer burger cooked medium with a side of play cheese and they brought me mayo but it wasn't even our waitress who brought out the food so by the time we found her again it was 10 minutes later, her food was cold and then we had to wait another 10 minutes for the condiments to be brought out. My burger was cooked well done and it was actually hard to eat because it was so dry but I was so hungry at that point I couldn't wait any longer. So then when we asked to pay the check, tell table tablet wasn't working and they had to figure it out how to fix that and so we asked for our desserts to go while we were paying the check but they ended up taking almost 20 minutes to come out and that was after walking around the restaurant to find our waitress to ask her where they were. Definitel

The SHOR has NEVER disappointed!! We've been here many times as locals over the years and it continues to be my husband's number one spot. The calamari steals the show EVERY.SINGLE.TIME. I did not get a pic, we enjoy it so much we put our phones down. Can you believe that? We tried the crab cake this time. It was phenomenal, as expected. The perfect mix of crab, breadcrumbs and spices. I'd definitely order next time. 

So the grilled chicken and filet with the worlds best mashed potatoes, would completely grant another 45 minute drive to this number one beach spot view in America - again and again! However, the vegans that visited us had the hugest smile on their face while they were accommodated. They ordered a tempeh dish and were pleasantly surprised. In addition to a fabulous dinner, Shout out to Ben. You went above and beyond our expectations. Thank you for an incredible, unforgettable evening dinning in Clearwater Beach with family.

If you want a fabulous dinner I 100% would recommend this restaurant. Local or not, Vegan or not! An incredible experience.

What a delightful find. If you are looking for a delicious cozy place for brunch, put Sabrina's on your list. The French Toast is amazing. We had the pumpkin stuffed French toast with a mascarpone pumpkin topping. Not overly done. Subtle notes of pumpkin. Also at the table was cannoli French toast. Very sweet, tender and loads of cannoli flavor. I went for the meatloaf Benedict. Yes, you heard it correctly, meatloaf. A savory piece of meatloaf over spinach and a toasted roll. Then a poached egg over top. Try it. You will enjoy it.  I plan on going back to explore more of their menu.

The slowest service, not always professional but the food is good. No one greeted us, I had to ask for service. Fortunately the waitress rushed our order. We'll go back for the good food, but we'll just get it to go.

I was so excited to try Oscars. Since I've moved here it's all I have heard about. Well, I ordered through Postmates. I ordered the shrimp quesadilla. It definitely wasn't what I expected. It was really good though. However, after two bites a piece of shrimp fell out and it wasn't deveined. That's absolutely disgusting.
I got the Carolina Sandwich and the fried pickles. Both were lacking in flavor. My chicken was soggy and the pickles were mostly breading with only a tiny bit of actual pickle.

The best part of my meal was my drink from  the bar. If you want BBQ  go to the other spots. I had the Junior the brisk wasn't to my liking felt that it was under cooked. The smoked turkey was ok. The Mac n cheese had a gritty texture that I couldn't get with.

Very sad it's come down to this.   One star tonight because I can't give them zero.  Wifey and I went yesterday (Saturday) night because heretofore the beef lo mein has been to die for.  Last night we almost did.  

The dish that was brought to us tasted like a box of salt mixed with soy sauce.  It was awful.  It was so bad we couldn't eat it and was the first time we couldn't even take it home.  We also ordered one of the chef specials and it came out with the same full on salt attack.  It was embarrassing and an insult to be served such garbage.  

This was not a case of oh, it's a little to salty for me or oh, got a little more salt in it then needed.  No.  This was complete incompetence in the kitchen.  

Pity the server who had to bring it to us.  She was so wonderful and took such good care of us only to be betrayed by whoever was in the kitchen.

Unfortunately, we will never return.  On to the restaurants that take pride in what they serve.

Perfect breakfast spot away from the hustle and bustle of Bourbon and Frenchmen. Food was flavorful, plentiful, and reasonably priced. Turkish coffee was sweet, served with a water and a Turkish Delight on the side. Service was quick and attentive. 
I can't get over the atmosphere. It was quiet, cozy, and had plenty of room and parking.

Highly recommend to anyone looking to take a few steps off of the party scene and grab a nice breakfast.
Delicious breakfast borritos and coffee. Our favorites were the melty mushroom and the bacon and potato, but the #6, 7, and RHS burrito were tasty too. Definitely worth seeking this place out.

I'm extremely confused as to why this place is currently sitting at 3.5 stars - maybe it hasn't paid Yelp their monthly shakedown dues? The food is excellent and plentiful. It's spicy, salty, funky and even the banchan are delicious. Not only is this the sole Korean restaurant within twenty miles, it's actually great too??? 

Wilmington isn't exactly overripe with excellent dining options, especially Asian restaurants. I plan to make this a weekly trip after my first takeout today! Don't let the absolutely incorrect Yelp score deter you - try this place NOW.

Costumer service was horrible From this guy he wanted to start a fight that says a lot from a place management is a shi* show, the cashiers are great and friendly but this dude on the picture omg for me costumer service is all in a place so that's why I don't recommend at all this place just for him

I got extra sides and bread for free with my meal which was 10/10 the fresh noodles were great i cant wait to order again. Also got the chicken parm and that was super moist and the sauce was great. If you're thinking about getting it get it
Very yummy and quick take out after walking in and ordering to go from the vestibule take out window. We had a spicy girl roll and spicy shrimp tempura roll and they were ready in 15 minutes.

We love coming here for happy hour (Thursday nights are our favorite!). It's an atmosphere that is intimate enough for a much needed convo as well as a place where a group could relish a good meal. The service is great, I can walk there (+1 ME!) but, overall, it's just a great little spot. Casual for a beer, fancy for a meal- best of both worlds!
Good location in French quarter, casual down home ambiance.  Staff is nice but service is s-l-o-w.
Tried for first time. Food is disgusting and place is dirty!! Customer service is definitely lacking. Do not patronize

Received my delivery via Uber eats without knowing it was on my front door. It was cold, I threw it away. Could not get in touch with Uber eats, no one answers the contact number and IHOP says it was out of their control. Will never use Uber eats again.

I've gotten to the point in my life where I will only return to restaurants that are clean, employ friendly people and last but not least serve good food. I've found all that at the Liberty Bell in the Parx Casino in Bensalem, PA. My husband and I were so taken back by the efficiency and ultra good experience at this restaurant that I needed to review. Our server, Melissa was top notch. With her ready smile, she guided my husband and me in our food selections with her full knowledge of every item on the menu. Atmosphere, delicious "farm to table" type dining skillfully prepared, great prices, it's all there! We'll be back many more times!

Breakfast food served in less than 15 minutes. Order at the counter and grab a seat while your meal is prepared. The dining room is small, so avoid bringing your party of 20 here. But you can always order to go. If you want to avoid going inside, order at the drive-thru instead.

Always, always order the fresh squeezed orange or grapefruit juice. My most favorite dish here is the baked oatmeal. It's made with a seasonal fruit (most recently peaches, but I've also had apples) and topped with yogurt (a vegan yogurt is also available) and local honey. It's served with fresh fruit or potatoes. I've never ordered the fresh fruit because the fried, smashed potatoes and never disappointed- served a little crispy on the outside, creamy on the inside, well seasoned.

They have weekly specials posted on social media that someone with me always orders. Never disappointed unless they are sold out.

The drive-thru is efficient, especially during the current dining room shut down. They are even offering local milk, eggs, bacon for sale as part of a mini farmers market alternative (order ahead on their website).

I have never been disappointed at The Dandelion.  Start with the House Ricotta and if you have enough hearty eaters go for the cheese board too.  The liver parfait is delicious for those who appreciate liver.  I have friends who always get the Fish & Chips because they love them so much.  I've tried the Burger, Shepards Pie, Salmon and Risotto.  All are worth another go, but it is tempting to get the Fish & Chips again and again.  Dandelion can really make you long for a trip to an English Pub.  Our recent trip to London proved that the food is better in Philly.

I purchased food from them on several occasions the wait time is always long but normally the food is good. However it seems like they have different people cooking on different days because today the food was nasty. I purchased turkey wings with macaroni and cheese. The turkey wings were not fresh even though they just opened. The consistency of the gravy was slimy you can tell it was reheated. The Mac n cheese tasted like the dairy went bad it was the nastiest thing I have ever tasted and made me sick. Not to mention I was missing some items I ordered and paid for. This is the 3rd time I received my order with items missing. I tend to order using DoorDash since Im busy working and can't go in person. This was their last chance with me i don't appreciate being served DAYS old food when they charge $25 for a large turkey leg platter Mac n cheese and rice. I will not order from them again!!!!!!
I'm handicapped, and I just had great service. I really appreciate that. Thumbs way up!! The food was good, too! Excellent vegetable soup.
Great service, chill vibe, and amazing food. Really sweet workers who are very accommodating. The pico rojo sandwich is my favorite, their mustard sauce is to DIE for.

Spencer was awesome and recommended fantastic food, drinks and other places to visit while in town!! Also right on the beach and covered outside seating with perfect view of the ocean!! Added to our always go list!!

Eh, just ok. The rice had the texture and taste of par-boiled or minute rice. The ninja chicken was ok, lots of spice but not a lot of flavor. Hubby's teriyaki chicken as seasoned well, but the sauce was way too sweet. Potstickers were very good, but beware, the dipping sauce has a kick. The kids in our group were caught off guard.
Their online ordering and curbside pickup was very convenient. 21+ can order and pick up adult beverages! A bigger menu, and more options, than other popular teriyaki places.
When we were planning on going (Aug 12, 2020) they were not open for dine-in. Plan accordingly.
Good addition to downtown Kuna, but there are better teriyaki places. I wouldn't seek them out, but wouldn't turn their food away. We took our dinner over to the park nearby and it was a pleasant outdoor dinner.

We found this nice spot today.  I had the lamb chop special and my friend had pasta.  And we shared bruschetta.  All delicious, reasonably priced and served by an excellent waiter in a comfortable environment.  A great find in downtown St. Pete.
Best brunch in Indy. So fresh and delicious. My favorite is the gurner Benedict. So goood. Avon tomato jam. Perfect bread. Love the potato cake. Don't care for the sausage.

Get it while you can. Cul de Sac is one of the places where they do sell out-and often. Now you might think it's because of poor planning-no, no not so. It's because their food is so good -so amazing-their customers come and clean them out. 

Although it's vegan-it tastes so good. When people think of vegan restaurants, they usually think bland, boring and mostly salads. But that is not the case here with cul-de-sac at all!! Been a few times and I've enjoyed his nacho stack and the gargantuan burger. And each time I forget I'm eating vegan dishes. You'd be surprised that you're eating walnuts and not an actual burger-it's soooo delicious. And the thing is-you can feel good about eating his food-because everything is plant based. 

His chakra smoothies are also great. They're served in a glass mason jar. The owner is conscious and aware of the dangers of using plastic-so he chooses to use glass jars so you can throw one of the plastic ones you have at home away. 

I'm not sure if has call ahead ordering-making the wait a little long (for someone who likes to go during my lunch hour) I have to get there order and run back. I understand why some companies do this (because people show up late or not at all and they lose out on product) but it ruins it for the rest of us. 

But if you're looking for a great vegan-conscious place to eat-have a little time to wait for your food-definitely come and check out my friends at Cul De Sac.

If you have been to one Teppanyaki restaurant, then this one is like those. I love Teppanyaki and they did it right. The chef was entertaining and the food, service, and atmosphere were right on par. My kids had a blast catching the food in their mouth thrown by the chef. It was the highlight of their evening.

We love our fried chicken and often try to find the best chicken in the cities we visit. Gus' chicken was fantastic. And our server, AJ was incredibly helpful and added to the experience.

We ordered fried chicken with sides and sweet potato pie and a chocolate chess pie. Everything was excellent.

The chicken was crispy and juicy and tasty. The potato salad had a very unique flavor. Try it. 

It is a little bit away from the French quarter and we needed to take a Lyft out there but it was well worth the adventure.

This is really my favorite place in all of Indianapolis!  What can I say that hasn't been said....
-I love that this place does "Events."  If you haven't done the annual Oktoberfest, you are really missing out.   
-They have "knocked it out of the park" with outdoor seating during COVID times.  
-The FOOD!  Oh my gosh!!!!  I love the smoke rings on the brisket and how it falls apart.  The Chicken Quarters are also incredible, super smokey and tender.  
-The staff is also incredibly nice and professional.  
This is my favorite place because the food, environment, and staff just seem to provide a wonderful experience.

I stumbled across this place while doing my weekly shopping at the H-Mart in Upper Darby. It's in a small plaza with barely any available parking (which is laid, so bring your coins - .25 gets you 45 minutes). If you're having issues finding parking in their lot, there is plenty of street parking and lots in the area. This place really blends in with the restaurants from the outside but when you walk in it feels so much different. 

As soon as I walked into the door I was greeted by two very nice young women who were behind the counter. The space was a lot bigger than I would've imagined. The decor is pretty standard to a lot of boba/bubble tea restaurants I have been too. There is a small amount of seating in the restaurant if you'd like to eat in. 

I opted to get take out and ordered a Taro blended milk drink. It was actually really good, a tad bit sweeter than I usually like, but nevertheless it was good. Apparently, they are really known for their chicken which according to a sign takes 20-25 minutes to make (so if you're really hungry & in a rush skip back this time and come another

I think I will be returning on my next trip as it was very delicious,
Left our food languishing in the window for a long time.  Refused to give it to me when I asked for it.  They had to deliver it to the table.

Very good food, but service slow even with the limited number of customers. The only time we have been there with NO wait to get in. Kid had shrimp and cheese grits, hubby had po boy, I had the grilled shrimp salad. No complaints from anyone other than service. Just not outstanding enough this time to rate higher.
Great service great food..so glad they are surviving threw all this crap...ty..been coming here since I was a kid..

I love the food, it's my go to when I don't want to cook. I'm at this location about twice a week. My weekend routine for breakfast Saturday or Sunday morning it's "The Bissell Breakfast" or "Crab Cake Benedict". When I go I know that there usually be a wait, dont mind. The word about good food gets around. The service is great, but when I receive my food with 5 min the check is on the table! With "Oh no rush, I'll just leave this here for you.  Really ! So any thing I order after is free? I usually tip well. But when this happens I usually tip $2.00 Think I'll stick to Bensalem location.

SANDWICHES! Who doesn't love a good sandwich? Plus when you've got a sandwich shop that falls under the same umbrella as the likes of Three Boars, High Dough, and Wishbone... You know that they've gotta be good. VUE Weekly named Farrow as the #1 Best Sandwiches 2018 and Avenue Magazine awarded them Best Sandwiches 2019 and Best Quick Meal 2020. They started out as one small location in Garneau in 2014 but have since expanded to three different shops (all in pretty hip areas of the city). I am someone who loves to crush a good sandwich and have been very excited to try Farrow for a long time. I popped into their original location on a gorgeous Friday fall evening. It should be noted that the Garneau location is the only one of the three that stays open until 7pm, making dinnertime sandwiches possible. The rest operate more as breakfast or lunch spots.

The shop is small, with a chalkboard menu, a counter to order at, and not much else. The colour scheme is a somewhat graphic-styled black and white. The focus is solely on sandwiches, coffee and baked goods. It completely embodies the idea of providing an easy place to grab a quick (yet delicious!) breakfast or lunch on the go. And that's exactly where Farrow stands out and apart from the rest: this place offers quality.
The sandwich menu usually involves four different choices. Two of the sandwiches are always on the menu and are always available, while the other two rotate every few weeks. I figured that it would be a good ide
Love this place great for family gatherings great food friendly service. Lots to choose from.

Love the food and the friendly faces! The inside is adorable, unfortunately can't go in right now but they have a window where they can serve you. Food is fantastic. I can honestly say whatever you order it ends up being delicious. I do have my favorites (Wahl burger and the snootz) but I love ordering the special cause I know it's going to be good and creative! Desserts are to die for (shout out to vegan treats!) Highly recommend for all my vegetarian and vegan friends!

Warning if you have children you are not welcome. If you are a family and live in St Pete don't ever go to Left Bank Bistro.  I was Sooo excited to try this place. We have a lot of choices in St Pete but we chose this place for our 5th wedding anniversary. My daughter got all dressed up and was soo excited to go to the "pretty resturant yayy". We got there and she was so excited that she ran in saying wow yayy . Being 2 and not understanding how it all worked she ran past the hostess. So I grabbed her and went back to the hostess. Some rude waiter almost runs into us. The hostess kindly asked if we had a reservation. We said no. We had never been there before. She told us I am sorry but the wait will be 30 minutes. Understood as it was a Friday night. Then this girl comes up looks at my little girl and was like "um it will be an hour an hour wait". It was obvious my daughter was not welcomed by her. Even the other hostess was caught off gaurd. Keep your over priced butter and gawty wayfair furniture!  Our money is just as good as everyone elses and you will never see a dime. My daughter is kinder and more well behaved than your staff. Sorry her excitement to be there was such a bad thing to you.    My poor little girl cried all the way back to the car saying " pretty resturant I want to go to pretty resturant" I am still tearing up about it.  No one treats my family like that! You open a resturant in a mostly residential area and discriminate agaist families. Good luck!

We visited this place because of its great location at the beach. However, that was the extent of the good part of the experience. The service was almost nonexistent and was very inattentive. We had crab cakes and salad. The salad was stale. The crab cakes were bland. The iced tea was like water. The prices were high. We were thoroughly disappointed. We will not return.
I'm visiting from Oklahoma.  We tried the the blackened gator. Lemme tell you it was delicious! I never knew something so mean could taste so good!
Had the fish tacos and the kababs. They make it fresh when you order it. I'll be back!!!!

I couldn't wait to visit and had heard great things about their Malvern location. It totally lived up to my expectations and then some! The food was delicious and the service was warm and friendly. I had the penne alla vodka and cheesecake. I'm confident this spot could satisfy anyone regardless of their dietary preferences. 

I'm beyond ecstatic to have a totally vegan spot in the neighborhood. Fairmount was severely lacking in vegan options. I hope they continue to thrive and help many people embark on a journey to a more compassionate, healthy way of living. I can't wait to go back! 

My only wish is that there were more gluten free options

Best coffee hands down! 
Really neat meeting rooms. 
Such a nice place.  Unique. 
Employees are friendly.
Try the Ice Salted Carmel a must!!
Everything I've ever eaten here is delicious. I am obsessed with the tuna sandwich. The owner is always nice and the food is fast. Always a go to

Food looks as good as the pictures! Had the cream brûlée French toast. It's was amazing! You have to order this!! Also enjoyed the dunk  your donut martini it was  also delicious. My little one ordered the mini pancakes and bacon off the kids menu. Unfortunately they were out of the monkey bread heard that was amazing have to try that next time. Also ordered the breakfast tacos tasted great but came out cold they took it off the bill. Overall everyone was very happy with their food and drinks we were there on Super Bowl Sunday! Go Buc's!!!

Cool joint. Stopped in after my sister picked me up from the airport. This place is not far from her house so she has been wanting to try it because of the cauliflower pizza. 
When we walked in it was very quiet and had only a few customers at 1:30 PM. Also, as we learned, it looked like there was only one server who was also the bartender. That and the fact that they messed up on our pizza and had to redo it is why I am not getting it five stars. The house boom bazz salad was excellent, and the cauliflower pizza was fantastic as well. Check this place out.

Stopped by House of Bread this morning to pick up a few things. I like their carrot bread with walnuts and their pumpkin bead. I always buy the large loaves as they're only $9.50 and they stay moist for over a week. I've also discovered their fruit preserves. I bought a strawberry and it's full of flavor, plus a 20 ounce jar is only $6.50.  I could stop by every day for one of their giant cinnamon rolls and at $3.50,  it's the size of a luncheon plate! I usually heat it  up a bit in the microwave and the brown sugar and the cinnamon sugar melt together to a gooey yummyness. 

The only thing I wouldn't recommend at this point are the cookies. I bought two extra large Valentine heart cookies last week and even my husband, who eats all cookies, did not enjoy them. They were hard and almost bitter tasting, plus the chocolate frosting on one was waxy and the white frosting on the other was grainy. Needless to say I threw 98% of both cookies in the trash. Disappointing to say the least, as they were to be our valentine dinner dessert. 

On the plus side, Staff are always friendly and helpful. There's plenty of parking. It's a great place to meet a friend for coffee or a tea and enjoy a fresh baked goodie while catching up and enjoying the outside air at one of their convenient sidewalk tables. 

Only a three star average  today (1 star for inedible cookies and 5 stars breads plus).

Coffee shop and take out counter downstairs, full service upstairs. I got a veggie breakfast burrito - it was really great! Full of vegetables (red pepper, broccoli rabe, onion, spinach) and grilled too! They have hot sauce packets to go, which is awesome if you like hot sauce as much as me! It's cash only, and they have an ATM.
This my second time here. And the food and service is excellent! I highly recommend this place for authentic Cuban food. I'll return every time I'm in town from Los Angeles.
The food and service are outstanding. Loved the grill and how well the restaurant is ventilated.

Thank you for a delicious lunch last Saturday! We all loved the food, and appreciated your patience filling our water bottles. We hope to come back!
- your friends at New York Cycle Club

This place is amazing. Their staff is very nice and they have big servings. I also thought prices were really good.It also tasted amazing. Great area to hang out with fam. I recommend getting a medium size cause the big is to much it taste so rich and filling.
Some of the best Thai food I ever had! The pho is awesome and the customer service is great. My husband who is reluctant to ever try anything new loves it here too.

Some of the best breakfast in Midtown! The Gourmelt Bene was one of the most delicious variations on Eggs Benedict that I ever had. Picture half a grilled cheese sandwich in place of the English Muffins and chopped bacon on top. My wife had the Pancake Dippers which are pancake strips with bacon strips inside. Both were delicious! Service was good and my coffee cup was kept full of excellent locally roasted coffee. I love that they offer local non-GMO eggs as well as duck eggs forntheir dishes. There is also an impressive menu of adult beverages way beyond the typical mimosa, bloody mary, Irish coffee offerings you see at most restaurants.
Absolute best pulled pork and brisket! We eat here at least once a month, their sides are great too. The corn casserole and Mac n cheese are must try's.

So I chose this restaurant based on the menu.  It appeared to be quite authentic.  That assumption proved correct.

Upon sitting down I was promptly greeted.  I asked for a water then asked if they could make Choo Chee.  She said yes and I promptly gave the menu back with a smile.  Based on her recommendation I chose fish over shrimp as the protein.  It was fantastic.  If you have visited Thailand you know.

Kob-khun krab 

Scott

So yummy! We just finished eating! Lamb gyro, lamb burger, beef platter and lentil soup. Wish the fries were hot and crispy. Atmosphere is nice. Wonderful music. And a great collection of SLR cameras in a corner case.

I am shocked that I am just learning about this establishment. Friendly staff, awesome smoothies, delicious vegan food items, cost effective and healthy. I could go on about the various items I tried so my only suggestion is to explore for yourself.

****HIGHLY RECCOMEND****
Everything was simply amazing!
If you are craving Indian food, you must go to Minerva. If my girlfriend is ever missing, she will probably be here.

What to know:
- Very affordable menu: Most appetizers are $10-15 and entrees are $25-30. However, they are currently offering $30 and $50 prix fixe options that include 1 app, 1 entree, and 1 dessert (price difference depends on whether your entree was more than $30).
- BIG portions: Gf and I each did the prix fixe menu and had leftovers to bring home!
- Maybe it was just our amazing waitress Christine but we were able to substitute one of the desserts with an extra appetizer
- BYOB

What to get:
- Caesar Salad: A classic done right with homemade Caesar dressing!
- Lobster Bisque: Currently a special but perfect for a chilly night! Does not have actual lobster chunks though FYI
- Ribeye Steak: Juicy steak with a surprising Gorgonzola balsamic glaze and mash potatoes. Delish!
- Nutella cannoli: Doesn't get any better than this

What to avoid:
- Frutti di Mare: Came with a ton of seafood which was amazing but the pasta itself was unseasoned and pretty dry.
- Prosciutto Wrapped Dates: Not what I expected. The dates are huge and the prosciutto is crisped. If you're expecting Spanish tapas-style (as I did), you will be disappointed.

All in all, great local dinner spot with a well-priced prix fixe menu (and you can save money on drinks with the BYOB)

Bagels plus... simply the best and the only thing that comes close to a NY bagel anywhere around here. I mostly stop in before work for a sesame lox bagel or san everything w cc. The bagels are so fresh that early in the morning that you don't even need to toast them for the perfect bite. The shop is always full with local professionals and officers grabbing breakfast. Everyone at work loves these bagels so much that we've asked management to get them for breakfast meetings. They're so popular that I once stopped in for a dozen bagels on Father's day and had to be limited to a half dozen...I wasnt even mad bc I understood why they had to do it. 

Anyway...if you like bagels just go check 'em out. I like the veg cc, jalapeno is good too if you're in the mood for it.

I've had a big bowl of soup from this place before, but the bowl I had recently was absolutely horrible. It was the hand drawn noodles with beef and tendon. There was more tendon than beef and the broth tasted nothing short of water with a little bit of a beef flavor. I was able to revive the taste with a lot of sauces, but overall the tasting experience was subpar. I gave this place 3 stars because the staff was the sweetest and the other dishes I've tried from here have been decent.

I don't want to be entirely negative. The food was tasty. The containers they use for takeout were all wrong. My fries burned through the styrofoam container by the time we made it home. I got the $52 meal deal. The meat (ribs and chicken) were dry and chewy. This was my second time eating here and it was disappointing. They stepped up their game a bit on the Mac n cheese. It seemed better than it was the first time I tried it. Over all meh.

This place is the perfect hole in the wall style place. Pizza and Boba may be a strange offering but they nailed both of them.  Only $5 for a two topping personal pizza way better than any takeout place. And the Milk Tea Boba was amazing.

This place is a hidden gem, that we happen to walk by the previous day on way to breakfast. Lets start by saying the everything is made in house and if your a sweet lover like me, it's not which one do I want it's more like how many do I want! We started with with the Tennessee Prosciutto & Ricotta twist a very flaky and saltness to this, but oh  man was it good. This was so fresh and amazing that I couldn't wait to try the pecan roll. Let's just start out saying I should have taking more time on this picture, because it doesn't do it justice. It was so soft and delicious and had an inch of the Pecan topping on it, I could have stopped here and been completely happy.. However sandwiches were ordered so on we go. The first sandwich was a Chicken sausage, which had free range egg, chicken sausage, sautéed greens, white cheddar, roasted tomato mayo. This sandwich was so good served on a warm homemade bun. then onto the next sandwich Bacon, Egg, and Cheese sounds basic but again served on the toasted warm bun and a roasted tomato mayo, very good. Hours are limited 7am to 2pm Monday to Friday, and 8am to 2pm Saturday and Sunday. So get there early you don't want to miss out on this hot spot.

We love this place.  The fish is tremendous, always fresh and the best on the beach.  Service is fantastic, wine is a generous pour and the atmosphere is great.  It is a perfect Florida Combination and a MUST place to visit!

Finally got to go here for Drag Brunch and what an experience! Their brunch is definitely one of the best in the city. The food is great and service is excellent. Phil, the bartender, knew his food/drink menu very well. 5 stars for Phil and for the Country Club.

I love this place!  Always good food and service. The servers have been there for years and it shows. You can't go wrong eating here. The fish tacos are really good. In the summer you can sit out on the patio and it's so nice. This is my go to for Mexican food.

Oh my gosh what an incredible experience and evening at the Pelican Club courtesy of Ms. Denise. 
We literally had no idea what we were in store for. From the time we were greeted at the door to the time we sat and met our wait staff Denise and her co workers it was such a delightful evening with our Daughter 22 and son 17. Denise took such great care of us on our daughters birthday and helped us with our menu selections! 
But... more than that we felt like Denise was our new  "friend" she shared her love of Nola and gave us information on places to see. Our daughter is a history major and wanted to chat w Denise...Denise would write info on our table and tell us a quick story then deliver drinks to another table and come back. With Covid times her special care and consideration to connect with her guest was really just so incredibly cool. We loved the Pelican Club but Denise and others who work there draw us back like a guest in their home. Feeling  so blessed great meal and so much more.
This is probably our most favorite wing spot. Reasonable prices and great food! We get the Big Meal Size 24 12 medium 12 mild sauce. Hasn't  disappointed yet!

We ordered 2 Poke ceviche bowls & 2 spam musubi via door dash earlier this week, during covid-19 season. Poke bowls are very filling but not that delicious, have had better elsewhere. Musubi was ok tasting too.

As many of the reviews mention, this place is small, the parking is minimal...BUT it's a diamond in the rough. I was a huge fan of Jo To Thai Sushi on Dale Mabry. However, they closed their doors permanently. Clearly, I was immediately on the hunt for another go to spot near me in Westshore and it looks like I found it.

There were 4 of us eating in total. We ordered chicken pad thai, drunken noodles with chicken, chicken and shrimp thai fried rice, and 2 order of veggie egg rolls.

**Pad Thai and Thai Fried Rice: Both these dishes receive a 5 by me. The Pad Thai was perfect. Not too oily, just enough sauce, and the right amount of chicken. I actually split this dish with a friend and still had some left over. The Fried Rice was my BF's so I gave it a taste and it was seasoned to perfection and the veggies looked and tasted so fresh. He finished it...although he probably shouldn't have! 

**Drunken Noodles: While I didn't try this dish, I was told it was good; just enough spice, fulfilling without being an overload, and was even better the next day. 

**Veggie egg rolls: These were tasty...everyone loved them and none were left. They were fried just right and filled with veggies but cabbage more than anything...my favorite!

The pizza was fine but they were NOT prepared to accommodate for the COVID-19 outbreak. I did not see a single employee wear a mask and I highly, highly doubt they were washing their hands between transactions, or at all. All the customers were clustered outside, with no markers to stand six feet apart. Basically no precautions were taken to prioritize customer or staff safety, aside from closing their dining area. On top of that, several customers and I waited for 30 minutes only to be told that their online order system was malfunctioning so they did not have any online orders ready and would need to take our order numbers. Their solution to this was to take our phones to get our orders numbers, because apparently they don't own pen and paper? All in all, I waited 45 minutes to get a small pizza. It was an incredibly unorganized and unprofessional process. If you are at-risk or are concerned about COVID, I highly recommend not coming here.
Their flour is wonderful for artisan bread.  That being said, their bakery is the best in Ada County.
It's amazing. The food was very delicious. The waitress was kind and so cute. I love it and definitely will come back. The whole dinner ( pictures) only 85$, a very reasonable price.

There are a lot of things that people grade places about! Some people like the generic consistency of places like Starbucks, Dunkin Donuts, and Taco Bell! And some people it's like Juan Valdez. Or Helm's bakery man or visiting Mexico?  this place is a more along the lines of the latter. This feels like your best friend's place around the corner that you like to just go down and hang out in. I travel all the states on a regular basis and I only go to Starbucks or Dunkin Donuts when I can't find a little place like this. so I walk in and they are very nice and and they asked me what I would like and I described it to them and then I noticed the bakery case. So as I often do, I asked them what they would like or what they would pick since I'm just traveling through town, if they had to choose but I was trying to become a less of a man than I once was so calories were kind of a question although I had my eyes on one of those big beautiful cinnamon rolls!! They started off by explaining why all They started off by explaining why all the sub 50000 calorie items would be good and then as they went by the cinnamon rolls.... they paused? so I got a cinnamon roll and a coffee and now I know why they pause is they went by it was delicious and the coffee was exactly what I asked for although it wasn't commercial grade? It was only made it's like I wanted it to be which for some reason seemed to be exactly how the cinnamon roll was made?
This place has really great food ! I personally had the Ribs and Mac & Cheese and it was great ‼

My family loves this place. Food and service are consistently good. The wait for tables moves fast. Portions are large and I love that carafe of coffee lands on the table almost immediately. Food ain't fancy, just solid and served quickly. Sometimes that's all I need on a Sunday morning. 

The bakery has delicious offerings so don't forget to grab a cake or pie on the way out.

There's something about the hand made pasta that makes Convivio stand out in the upper echelon of Italian restaurants. We recently celebrated a Valentine's Day dinner here and couldn't have been more pleased. 

They had a specific menu for the Valentine's weekend, which included some specials not usually on the traditional menu. Reading over the choices will give you a chance to practice an Italian accent, and probably learn a few new words (I admittedly had to google a few things to learn what was in each dish).

We started off with the 'classica' bruschetta. We weren't aware that they bring complimentary bread and oil to the table, so when the bruschetta and bread arrived at the same time, we had ourselves a little laugh. The bruschetta was pretty heavy on the tomatoes and light on the mozzarella, but the basil and olive oil gave it a nice flavor. 

For entrees, I ordered the 'Manzo' which was a pappardelle-type pasta dish with seared peppercorn beef tips and porcini mushrooms in a dijon brandy cream sauce. My girlfriend got the 'Tortellaci' which comes with 4 large spinach tortelloni stuffed with chicken, ricotta and parmesan cheese, topped with mushrooms and a taleggio cream sauce. Both entrees were specials on the V-day menu. 

The Manzo was absolutely phenomenal. The seared beef was delicious and the sauce had a light, smoky flavor. I would be disappointed if it only remains as a V-day special, because it was the best pasta dish I have had in a long time (certainly sinc

Takeaways: it's cute, it's tasty, but only visit if you have all the time in the world to wait for (or correct) your order

This is a super cute coffee shop to visit...hadn't visited one with decor or theme like this, so it definitely has a fun vibe as soon as you walk in. 

Though the drinks and food are good, the customer service is sloooowww. The past three times we've gone, it's taken at least 15-20 minutes to make our coffee and food (a simple breakfast biscuit or turkey sandwich...which shouldn't take that long to make). Our friend also recently visited and the staff had completely forgotten her food. It wasn't busy; the staff was just talking while she was waiting for her food to arrive. So all of this paired with the high prices of a trendy coffee shop is not ideal. 

This coffee shop has a lot of great potential, but there is opportunity to improve their work streams, training process, and customer service. If they can work through the kinks and have a faster turnaround time with orders, we would definitely visit more often. For now, we'll only visit when we have all the time in the world to wait. Or just go to Frothy Monkey.

This is the worst restaurant I have eaten at in the past 25 years. The oysters were terrible, both raw and charbroiled. The spaghetti was a step under low grade buffet quality. They managed to mess up fried chicken...  I am in disbelief the level this establishment of 100 years has dropped to. Completely unacceptable. I would be embarrassed if I were the owner. I say this with love because I want this place to succeed, it has great potential!

Its good for a quick, yet expensive lunch  The salads are quite good. The options are plentiful.  The protein are high-quality meats, and there are a myriad of fresh veggies, fruits, nuts/seeds .  However, the "stir-fry" is not real stir-fry, it's more like fast-food sort of stir-fry.  Noodles, sauce, veggies, and meat are stirred around in a hot wok for a minute, but are nowhere near thoroughly cooked together and adequately browned like traditional stir-fry.  Traditional, flavorful high-heat oil like peanut or sesame oil is NOT used, nor do they start with garlic, ginger, etc. Size of the cut up veggies are puny.  Noodles are thin, not hearty and the portion of noodles compared to everything else is too much.  Veggies are not mixed in and often are at bottom or side of the bowl.  Sauce is excessive and watery.  On every order I end up with an large amount of sauce or dressing pooled at the bottom of the bowl, even when I say "less".  Order system is efficient but flawed; it does not allow you to say double or triple of one ingredient, or that you want your food well-done.  You have to get someone's attention, which is awkward because there is no dedicated cashier/host/counter-person.

Brian does a super job , jess too 
Great customer service 
A come back spot 
Nice view 
All team very attentive and welcoming

I am basing the two stars on management, the food was excellent,the wait time was short, bathrooms were clean, due to covid everyone was wearing masks.

But the mannerism of management was absolutely unforgivable. How you treat your employees is very important to me. She disrespected the cashier over something very small. 
Please remember as a manager you are an example and I was very offended as the customer to even witness while sitting in the waiting area.

I commend the cashier for keeping her cool and still giving me great customer service

I rarely review anything but I have to do it today.  I went to this Outback Steakhouse a few weeks ago (4/18/19) and we had ordered 'Chicken tender platter' and it was terribly salty. I can't believe how many salt they had on the chicken.  The New York Steak I ordered was pretty good but the chicken tender platter had ruined my whole dinner.  I hope the Outback Steakhouse management team on Baltimore Pike in Springfield, PA read this and try to correct their way of cooking.  We can't hardly eat salty stuff like this and it also raises up our blood pressure and it's not good for our health.

**DRAG BRUNCH REVIEW**  I've only been here for drag brunch, so my review is exclusive to that! I can't say enough great things about the brunch experience. The performers put on a great (and entertaining!) drag show. The effort they put into their outfits is impressive. We loved it!  

The brunch was buffet style. Hummus, fruit, eggs, pastries, bacon, sausage, some delicious flat bread/cracker, toasted potatoes and some yummy fried balls of potatoes and meat.  

Went with a small group of women and we loved it. Will definitely be back even if we just come for mimosas at the bar to watch the show!  I hope this fantastic event is well supported!

I placed an order for pick up. The order was ready in 2 mins.

There packaging is ordinary. No real difference in packaging from a cart on the street. I ordered broken rice with chicken. 

It was as simple as the name sounds -- pieces of grilled chicken on the side with a fistful of white rice and some salad.

May be the experience is different when you are sitting in the restaurant as eating.

I would also like to add that what you pay is what you get completely applies here :-)

I came with my girlfriends and we really enjoyed it! The food was delicious and the service was perfect. Justine our server was very attentive 100%. Definitely try the Iris roll and Macho Macho. By the way I loved the jalapeño dragon ball. Very yummy and it was not spicy at all. I definitely encourage you to come here.
OMG!! Looks can be deceiving, the food is definitely "THE REAL" Korean thing! I just found my new place for Korean. The cook doesn't talk much, but he speaks with his food!!!

I've been a loyal customer of this restaurant for over a decade. Like many Covid has taken its toll.  Servers could work at Waffle House , manager is the same .  There is no more personal service.  It's very sad. It starts with degradation of management. I need to find a new "go to" restaurant .  It's a super spreader for Covid as they pack as many in as they can fit. Don't pay the prices for a top drawer restaurant. I'll be surprised if they make it through 2021 .
The food is exceptional each and every time! MY LORD. The food is always SO FRESH and FLAVORFUL. Hands down this is one of the best casual Mediterranean eateries in the city. Delicious.
We waited at the counter for about 10 minutes and nobody helped us so we left. Don't recommend if you need something quick.

BOMB DOT COM! I tried their cold brew with vanilla syrup and their nitro draft cold brew. Both were amazing. Low in acidity, high in smoooooth flavor. And that vanilla syrup was to die for. Check this spot out when you need your caffeine fix! The inside had all kinds of tables and couches - it was really nice! They also had a couple tables outside if that's your cup of tea.

Five years ago the food and service was fantastic.  Now, it is dirty and those that work there don't seem to care if they do things right.  Two items in our order were wrong and they charged our family for four sodas ($8) when I told the person at the register three times we wanted water. It's a shame this is now behind Taco Bell for me when I think about Mexican food.
The food was decent.  Not great, not terrible.

This is a solid breakfast place with lots of classic choices, hash browns are nice and golden, delicious pancakes highly recommend the blueberry. One pancake is enough for 2 people it's quite large. Lots of choices for anyone you bring here. Great service and friendly staff.

This place has TERRIBLE customer service and are RACIST. A group of friends and I went to get a slice of pizza from the bar. I didn't add a tip to my ticket because I was going to pay cash and as soon as I was reaching in my pocket to get her cash tip the bartender aggressively asked "Why aren't you tipping me?" I told her that I was actually getting cash out of my pocket but felt attacked and did not feel comfortable tipping more as she was extremely unprofessional. She then continued to yell and tell everyone at the bar that I was a "black cheap ass". I left the bar immediately as I did not want to allow her to mess with my inner peace but I will NEVER go here again and if you are any POC you will more thank likely have the same experience, sadly. This truly saddens me. Do better!
Service was super slow! Took almost 20 mins to open a can and bring to the table! No one greeted us at all. Seemed like an inconvenience that we were here.

Came here for lunch today and I must say that I'm impressed. The lunch buffet is about $11 per person, and for the quality of food, this is definitely a good value! They offer Chinese and Japanese options and there's a lot to choose from. Between a wide array of sushi, many hot dishes, soup and salad, and dessert, it was hard to try everything I wanted to. Our dishes were promptly picked up and our water was refilled quickly and often. The decor is modern and simple, but it still has a buffet type of vibe. We sat right by the buffet --nice easy access-- and there's at least one skylight in that room, adding some excellent natural lighting. Overall, I left extremely full and satisfied, and I would definitely return.

I'm very glad this restaurant continues to stay open. I have had many great times here, with friends and family. A bottle of plum soju and kimchi fries are all I've ever needed to pass the time and enjoy hours of smiles with the staff. Truly a blessing to have in Little ol Reno

Absolutely, positively delicious.  I happened to walk by, it looked interesting and I stopped in.  The pastrami is grilled, so it tasty extra smoky, and the pastrami dip was terrific.  Can't wait to return!
One of the best pizza places around. All star staff and great specials. Make sure you check Facebook for the pizza of the week!

Wow wow wow. Blue crab avacado toast. Need I say more? Ok, Parisian gnocchi was also amazingly delicious. The one thing that was not fabulous was the cauliflower entree-at $27 I should have known better. Sad to say-it was too much cauliflower and not enough of the other ingredients. The roasted carrots are wayyyy better than the cauliflower. And don't miss the bread basket-holy carbs but it is worth it. We stopped by to place our order in person and they could not have been nicer-clearly care about quality and their customers. Looking forward to dining here again when I am in town.

Just the best place for breakfast in American cities like Indianapolis.  They've tore ally managed to flip breakfast into new possibilities, besides too much food. I like all the frittatas (which may not catch your eye), everY one.  I'm a maven for grits  and these are really good.  The avocado toast is a reliable favorite.  Best in town.   Top breakfast in Indy.

We stopped in for brunch and had the most amazing omelets and bottomless bloody Mary's. But more than that, our server April completely made the dining experience what it was. She was super kind and informative, and handled our personalities well! A restaurant is made great by its staff and April killed the game today. Thank you! -JD

We are from Mexico and in the last years living in the US it has been pretty hard finding something really Mexican and authentic. El trompo is a really cool place, locally owned and the closest you can get to the real thing in Nashville and Hendersonville. The service is awesome, the quality of the food is amazing, tasty real salsas and a wide variety of drinks. They even have flan which is a traditional dessert after packing tacos. Good ambiance and music, no problem with parking and always friendly staff. Prices are on par with service and food, not an expensive place.

The food reminds me of an authentic home cooked meal. As though I went to someone's house for a full breakfast. I ordered the Honey platter which comes with 3 pancakes, potatoes, meat and eggs. I added bananas, chocolate chips and whipped cream to the pancakes, each $1 extra. I also got the latke as my potato dish. Everything was very good. It did taste as though they sautéed/pan fried everything with butter. 
I really enjoyed the potato latke. The turkey sausage was okay. My friend ordered the home fries and they were perfectly crispy and seasoned very well. Great portion size. Would definitely come back again.
Omg best tacos I've ever had and the trio with all three sauces is amazing and a great deal. My mouth is watering thinking of the Baja shrimp tacos

Feels like I am trying to hit all of the Peg's in Reno!  Came to this one because my daughter just moved to the area.  I was a little worried coming on a Saturday morning and with every other table closed off, but no worries.  I was too tired to remember photos, but the food is still super top notch.  If you have been to another Peg's you know that the skillets are super large.  My son had the Monte Cristo sandwich - he was not ready for three full pieces of french toast as part of the sandwich.  Other dishes we had included the Hawaiian breakfast, one of the mexican skillets and more.  Service here is super nice.

Walked in.  Smelled terribly.  There were two employees that didn't acknowledge us at all.  We were in there for 5 minutes standing at the counter and no one said a word to us.  We walked out.  Wish I could have given a more comprehensive review but the staff ignored us.
Food was good as always, however, the restaurant was jam packed. I would say 100% capacity in spite of Covid-19. we had to wait in a cramped space for 30 minutes in spite of having a reservation.
No indoor seating and no use of restroom. We went elsewhere.  Realized reading yelp reviews we made the right decision.
Got skip the dishes from here. Pad Thai was a little dry and the curry was pretty good. Not the best Thai food we have ever had but still pretty good overall

The French toast is my favorite! And the hash browns are always delicious. One of the go to spots for breakfast for my husband and I. Cute fun atmosphere and the food is delicious.  When i am not looking for something sweet, the breakfast burrito ordered as a quesadilla (bacon instead of sausage) is amazing!

MOD Pizza was really good! They have delicious pizza and don't charge extra for all the extra topping should you so choose to add them! 
We always build our own and make them extra crazy - so this spot is a must if you always feel bad making the pizza crew make you the perfect, insane ass za.
Staff was super friendly and everything was COVID proof. Spaced out tables, masks, etc.
I do wish their beer choose was better. In general as a chain they could use actual taps with an array of beer. Beer and pizza go perfectly together!
All in all, really good experience. We've eating at other MODs and this one was really great.
Thanks guys!

Went for dinner last night to our local Bonefish. I always love to go there for the fresh fish!! Wine was good, bread was yummy, my grouper was extremely good.  My hubby ordered the Mahi and Shrimp with no special sauce (which made it kind of look dry but he had no complaints).  I love the ambiance here. Everything was great but I just wish they had better desserts!! The special dessert of the day was carrot cake (my least favorite). We did order the macadamia nut brown with ice cream. It was good and got my sweet tooth going.  I miss their creme brûlée.....and coconut pie.  Two of my all time favs.  They were training a lot of new staff. I overheard one of the servers telling a customer that this location will be closing once the new free standing restaurant opens across from the outlet mall!! Closer to me!! Bonefish never disappoints!

Went there today and ordered a turkey burger. It was awful. It was mushy slimy and had no flavor. The fries tasted like they were cooked in old grease and they didn't put ketchup in the bag. Very disappointing.
Excellent prices, easy to order online . I recommend the miso soup with any order . Loaded with tofu and seaweed
I have been here at least 15 times and never ever disappointed. Great food, great prices, and a friendly helpful staff that truly cares.
The food is so good!!! Great service and fun laid back atmosphere! I will definitely be back!

The Bixx Sticks were surprisingly pretty good for the happy hour price of about $3.50. Friendly bartender, good beer selection and very easy parking. The location is very dated though and had an odd smell at the bar (unpleasant) would return again but would not go out of my way to visit.

Sat down at 6 pm and walked out at 6:20 without ordering a single thing! EVERY SINGLE front of house staff member made a bewildered version of eye contact - as if they had just seen an alien spacecraft land mid restaurant....(and the bartender even had a very short joking conversation with us), yet not a single one came to offer a hello or drink as we sat in the semi busy bar area. Wait, we're we toxic? Did we have the plague? And maybe it was my husbands cologne? No. It was a massive and huge case of hot ineptitude! It was only after I stopped the obviously new, relatively oblivious and somewhat stoned looking young man that met us at the door -  if he knew which of the kids from flying pie kindergarten was supposed to attend to our table. He didn't have a clue what was going on, what was on tap - or that what we liked was no longer available.. and frankly I'm not even sure he knew where he was! Seriously disappointed in the service! We've spent a good deal of $ at this establishment but they've officially lost our business! It's cool though.. there's at least 4 other pizza places within a mile.

When we stay at Reno, we must always have to eat at least once a day at Pearls either just for snacking or dinner. This is always been my favorite place for there shrimp scampi. I have eaten different restaurant of there brand Shrimp Scampi and I always say Pearl's is better. I guess because they serve Scampi with there tangy rice and everyone have in noodles.  2 dozen oysters. I don't share my dozen oysters. At one sitting I ate 2 plates of Scampi and 2 dz Oysters.  Love love. Happy and Content. 

I already booked my room to come your way in couple of weeks. Going to meet Pearls my best friend that I can't live without. 

Service is always great and they would be shocked on how many things we order and finish everything. 2 adults and 2 kids. Now my kids starting love this place. 

Cioppino- we always shared this but it could sometime very salty.  Hit and Miss on this dish. Delicious but salty. 

Will coming in a few weeks Jambalaya, and there Roast Pan items not sure which will try. Update after I try it. 

A great place for fresh seafood and will recommend anyone to give it a try. Or just hang for beer and Oyster.

Had an amazing first experience and will be back! We had a group for a birthday and Ronda was extremely accommodating, we all wore masks and socially distanced! we ordered the taco platters and I also ordered the guacamole and the hot sausage breakfast burrito. The guac was definitely fresh and it was amazing. My boyfriend LOVED the breakfast burrito it was all a wonderful experience. The margs were a little too sugary for my liking, but they were still delicious for a hot day outside. 

Ronda and the chef were both super nice when it started to rain outside she opened her Air BNB next door for us to go in and not be in the rain. She cares for her customers and the food is authentic!

10 out of 10 would recommend to a friend :)

COVID-19 update, from KINGFISHER management, as of 11 May 2020: 
"We ... are going to wait for awhile before we ... open our bar and dining rooms. However, we will reopen for curbside takeout on June 2nd with a takeout specific menu. Hours for takeout will be Tuesday thru Saturday from noon-6pm. As far as when our dining rooms will open, we will probably wait until the end of June."

Best cheesesteak in Philly. I love the bread. Thank he wings were great as well. The staff was really nice to me and my daughter when I picked up the food. I would definitely return when I'm in the area.

Went again with friends and my sister. This place is so amazing. The food is so good. They follow covid regulations but it still brings you back to the fun times we had pre covid. Their pizza is so good and they are so fast at making it. Also the servers here are so nice they even remember the regular customers (like me lol) and were already making the pizzas I usually ask for. I highly recommend them for a good time and a full stomach!

I've tried calling the restaurant on Thursday and Friday for each of the last 2 weeks to place a take out order and no one ever picks up the phone. Once I got a busy signal and redialed and then no one answered. The other times, it just rang. I used both telephone numbers from Mi Niditos' own website. Is this place still open? Would love to patronize your business, but have not been able to!!! I've called between 11am-1pm, Thursdays and Fridays.

I had an oxtail platter with Mac n cheese and cabbage and a slice of chocolate cake today. The oxtails Mac n cheese and cabbage were delicious, the cabbage could be cooked more since I like mine tender and this wasn't. The chocolate cake gets 0 stars, it tasted like it had been in a smelly freezer and I couldn't eat more than 2 tiny tastes. I'll skip deserts from here from now on.

Went again for my birthday. This place is Amazing. My fiancee and I had the Halibut, Surf and turf, oysters, and scallops. The halibut was cooked perfectly mild, sweet tasting white flesh, large flakes and a firm but tender texture cooked to perfection. The lobster tail was nice and meaty with a perfect taste. The oysters were the best extremely creamy with a nice ocean taste. The Jumbo Sea Scallops were GREAT ! with Ruby Red Grapefruit, Capers, and Lemon Butter. Service was great. Thanks Again !

Well, disappointed!  This has been one of my favorite places since they opened.  Now, in these times I would think that they would put their best foot forward and make the guests experience the best. If you go into the restaurant, you get a plate oh hummus with veggies and pita bread. If you order takeout you don't. So guess they want you to come in and risk COVID to get everything. I still think their food is great but I am off getting takeout and since I can't get everything, like their great hummus. Guess I will be looking around. Terrible way to loose business!

With covid many worthwhile businesses are struggling.  Hopefully this one fails.  I have received better service at McDonalds.  

We went to this place because we were staying nearby.  Zero service when walking in and told we could seat ourselves.  After 15 minutes went to the bar to order drinks. NEVER saw a waiter/waitress though we were given menus.  Not sure why this place is ranked so well as they could clearly care less about the customers they do have.  

We will NEVER visit this place again as we can go to many other establishments and be ignored just as well.   Great place across the street call Whiskey Joe's.  First rate service and attentive staff.

I'm so disappointed. It's only been a few months since we've eaten here but it seems as though a lot has changed.  They seem to have gone the way of all the other Mexican restaurants-they became too American.  The food is not nearly authentic anymore.  I had the chimichanga and my husband had the chicken fajitas but let me tell you-we would have been better cooking our food. At least we would know how to season our food properly.   This will probably be the last time we visit here. It's just not good anymore. It's a waste of our money and time.  It's so bad that my husbands stomach started hurting. He couldn't even finish his meal.

Probably the worst experience I've had at Chipotle. 

The chips were at least a day or two old 

The guacamole was brown. 

The burrito was cold as ice, and tasted like a wet Baby diaper. 

I wound up just throwing it all away.

I SO want to love this restaurant/bar. The Don Cesar property is stunning, and having the option of outdoor dining, on the beach, watching those amazing sunsets while enjoying quality food and cocktails would be magical. Between the lounge areas, the fire pits, the indoor/outdoor interior, the space is great for families with kids to stretch their legs and be informal, but intimate and cozy enough for couples too. Unfortunately, the food is EH at best. There might be 2 items on the entire menu that will be consistently good, but I've experienced extremely dry burger, semi-frozen chicken wings, sand and chipped shells in my oysters... the food just is never that good. If they would improve on the quality of their food, it would be the best spot on the beach!

Let me start with the food tonight.... fantastic. Our server, Angel, also fantastic. Here's the problem... thankfully, we only dine outside because as a public health nurse I'm extremely aware that dining indoors is one of the best ways for Covid-19 to spread. As we were eating, we watched two ladies walk towards the main door and say "oh wait, we don't have masks. Oh well, they won't care". They proceeded to walk in. These women never came back out. About 15 minutes later, a third woman walked into the establishment without a mask, walked right past a girl cleaning the front door and nothing was said to her. This is extremely concerning to me and is exactly why I will not dine inside.  If this happens openly, what happens behind closed doors? What's happening in the kitchen? I hate to leave negative reviews, especially when the food and service was good, but the rules are being broken and I find this worrisome.
Always have GREAT service here. I'm a regular. One of owners know me by name which is cool. I love district because EVERYTHING is FRESH & made in house.

Was pretty good. I liked Bavarian bierhouse a little better. I will say their pretzel and beer cheese sauce was definetly better though. 

Service was about the same. Bavarian beir house had live music. We were here right when they opened and it does look like they have live music as well. 

The meet platter we got was ok. The brisket was good but didn't care for the ribs and the cheddar wurst. 

It's located in the heart of German town and considering a tornado went through and hit the area could also be why it was off. I've been in a couple tornadoes and it does take a while to get back to a normal way of life

Kudos to them for stating strong and remaining open.

Their beer was super delicious!!

Such an awesome experience from the food to the service... loved it all. Plus BYO! They also have everything spaced out well and clearly are taking proper precautions and doing contact tracing. Loved the pasta and the pizza - so authentic!

First time at new location.  Their smoked wings rock.  Got a brisket platter which was good but very small portions including the sides for the money.  Seems like they are cutting costs to pay for new location.  Was disappointed.
